text: Playfair's axiom, the standard modern replacement for Euclid's fifth postulate, states:
choices: Through a point not on a given line there is at most one line parallel to it
Through a point not on a given line there are at least two parallels
Any two distinct lines meet in exactly one point
All right angles are equal to one another
explanation: Playfair's axiom — 'through a point not on a given line there is at most one parallel' — is equivalent to Euclid's fifth postulate over neutral geometry. Option B is the hyperbolic parallel axiom, option D is Euclid's fourth postulate, and option C fails even in Euclidean geometry (parallels never meet).
